diffSummary: Added a Fetch Request/Response to Fastify inject adapter for EdgeOne Node.js Cloud Functions without starting a listening socket.
Added EdgeOne API and health catch-all entries that load the built Fastify runtime.
Mapped EdgeOne context env/clientIp into runtime configuration and request injection.
Made PostgreSQL pool size and timeouts configurable; default pool max is one for serverless runtime and prepared statements remain disabled.
Added an EdgeOne build contract for pnpm 9.15.9, Node 22.11.0, API build, and Vite static output.
rationale: Preserve the existing Fastify business and security boundary while replacing the always-on Railway listener with EdgeOne's request-driven free Node.js runtime.
